module: Module 3: Fractional Lot Rounding & Remainder Allocation
title: Extreme Fractional Division: 1.00 Lot Across 7 Sub-Accounts
precondition: 7 equal accounts ($10k each). Math: 1.00 / 7 = 0.142857 lots each.
expected: Two highest-priority accounts receive 0.15 lots; remaining five receive 0.14 lots; sum == exactly 1.00 lot.
coverage_note: No configurable remainder-distribution ledger, rebate ledger, or exact block-allocation policy was available for this requirement.
